ada_2026.title: 2. Diagnosis and Classification of Diabetes: Standards of Care in Diabetes—2026
ada_2026.verification_note: Rechecked on 2026-10-26: the indexed publisher PDF text of Tables 2.1 and 2.2 matches the supplied diabetes and prediabetes bounds. Direct retrieval of both the article and PDF returned HTTP 403. This source check is not clinical approval and does not validate the project's urgent-notice starting points.

interpretation_policy.bounds_semantics: A null bound is unbounded. Non-null bounds apply their explicit inclusive flag. All bounds are transcribed literally from AGENTS.md.
interpretation_policy.precision_policy: Do not round, convert, bridge gaps, or extrapolate to make a value match a band. Decimal precision and cross-unit equivalence require review under Q02.

random_plasma_glucose.source_note: AGENTS.md: random glucose is not used to classify normal or prediabetes. ADA 2026 Table 2.1 requires relevant symptoms for the supplied random-glucose criterion.

two_hour_post_prandial.source_note: AGENTS.md requires extraction of this test but supplies no classification thresholds. Do not reuse the two-hour OGTT bands; resolve Q06 with the clinical reviewer.

AGENTS.md, Clinical rules, fasting plasma glucose: at or above the supplied diabetes-range boundary; cross-checked against ADA 2026 Table 2.1. This is not a diagnosis.
